alcohol.title: Alcohol: How to Give It Up and Be Glad You Did
alcohol.description: This practical, comprehensive, and easy to use book helps alcohol abusers understand their behavior, but provides practical steps that anyone can use to solve an alcohol problem. Written by a cognitive-behavioral psychologist, this book includes chapters on overcoming low self-esteem, depression, stress, attending self-help groups, and living a better life after quitting. Each chapter contains specific self-help techniques. Recommended by SMART Recovery.

china-naval.title: CHINA'S GLOBAL NAVAL AMBITIONS: And Her Unstoppable Rise to Power
china-naval.description: Welcome aboard this thrilling exploration of the colossal waves crashing through the seas of geopolitical power! In "China’s Naval Aspirations and Their Success!", we ride the currents of ambition that drive China’s increasingly audacious maritime pursuits. Picture this: a nation deeply rooted in centuries-old maritime traditions, now re- emerging with a vengeance, flexing its naval muscles like never before. It's not just about ships and ports; it’s about the very essence of global power dynamics and what that means for the world! So, how did we get here? With an eye for detail and a pulse on the present, this book dives deep into the intertwined stories of China’s naval evolution, economic strategies, and the tantalizing geopolitical aspirations that loom large on the horizon. Each chapter unfurls a new layer of complexity, revealing the historical contexts that give rise to the present-day maritime ambitions. From the bustling shipyards echoing with the clang of metal to the sprawling ports sparkling like jewels on the global stage, we’ll witness the transformation of a nation as it seeks to reclaim its rightful place in the maritime realm. Let’s not forget the key players—meet the Chairman of the People’s Republic of China, the stoic architect of these ambitions, and the U.S. Naval Commander, representing a steadfast but challenged naval supremacy. With a mix of economic strategists mapping out pathways of prosperity and foreign affairs analysts who dissect the web of alliances and rivalries, we’ll explore the multi-faceted narrative that defines today’s maritime landscape. But hold onto your life vests! We’re not simply recounting historical events; we’re engaging in a dialogue about the future. The intricate dance of power, the grappling for influence, and the looming shadows of conflict weave a narrative that is both exhilarating and cautionary. As we approach the concluding sections, we’ll ponder how America might respond to the rising tides and what the future holds amid all this turbulence.

breach-trust.title: Breach of Trust: A tale of Asheville in the Civil War
breach-trust.description: This is a tale of old Asheville at the moment of Secession in 1860 at the cusp of the Civil War. Bankers with gold in their vaults weren't sure how to protect it.. So this banker decided to heist it and hide it. The consequences of this breach of trust causes a murder and a frame up shaking the confidence of the community and creating mystery across the Southwest as a manhunt endues and the community copes with the oncoming War Between the States.

singing-reels.title: Singing Reels: Sunburn
singing-reels.description: Singing Reels is a celebration of adventure, courage, and the unbreakable bond between humankind and the sea. Author Philip J. Tate takes readers from the roaring surf of the Gulf Stream to the peaceful rivers of the Blue Ridge Mountains, crafting vivid stories that capture both the thrill of the chase and the joy of the catch . Through every cast and sunrise, Tate explores more than just fishing—it’s about friendship, freedom, and finding meaning in nature’s rhythm. From the laughter that echoes across the deck to the quiet peace of a hidden cove, these pages remind readers why we seek adventure: to dream bigger, live bolder, and carry home stories that never fade. With cinematic storytelling and heartfelt reflection, Singing Reels immerses readers in the power and poetry of the outdoors. Whether you’re an experienced angler or simply someone drawn to the ocean’s call, this book will inspire you to rediscover joy, courage, and the beauty of life’s journey. Adventure is waiting. The waters are calling—cast your line and answer.
